messages:
maria: Quick sync — can someone run a quick smoke bench comparing int4 / int8 / fp8 for model-redwood-v2-7b, seq=1024, batch=8? I see a weird quality delta on the docs eval set.
ryan: On it. Queuing now. Which eval set and threshold should I watch? :eyes:
zara: use evalset 'docs-l1-v2' and check BLEU+ROUGE + our 'semantic-fail' metric. Flag any >0.5% drop in semantic-fail or >1% BLEU loss.
maria: thanks. Also include a short prompt slice that exposed the issue: """Summarize the following legal clause and highlight obligations.""" — short & long variants.
ryan: bench command I'm running: ```./bench-run --model redwood-v2-7b --quant int4,int8,fp8 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --eval docs-l1-v2 --prompts examples/slice_legal.json --out /tmp/bench-1857.json```
bench-bot: Job queued (id=jb-8592). Estimated run time ~ 14m.
kevin: FYI on hardware: use p4d-24 for int4/int8 and a8 for fp8 if available. Keep kernel-log on.
ryan: first pass results (quick summary): int4 throughput +38% vs fp32, latency p50 -12ms, but semantic-fail +1.9% on docs slice. int8: throughput +22%, semantic-fail +0.4%. fp8: throughput +30%, semantic-fail +0.9%. Raw numbers in /tmp/bench-1857.json
zara: can you paste the failure examples? If the semantic-fail spike is concentrated on a single prompt type we might tune KV caching/rounding.
ryan: paste a few failing outputs: ```
Prompt: "Summarize and list obligations"
fp32: "The lessee must..."
int4: "The lease must..."  <-- lost agent clarity
int4: conf scores lower, hallucinated 'lease' vs 'lessee' sometimes
```
maria: hmm that looks like tokenization/embedding drift rather than pure perf. Did we use the same tokenizer bindings for int4 runtime?
kevin: we used the quantized kernel with fused-tokenizer opt. I'll re-run with standard tokenizer shim to rule that out.
ara: (typo note) I meant to say 'kevin' not 'ara' earlier.
ryan: re-run queued with tokenizer shim and same seeds. Command: ```./bench-run --model redwood-v2-7b --quant int4 --shim tok_std --seed 42 --prompts examples/slice_legal.json```
bench-bot: Re-run queued (id=jb-8593). ETA 6m.
zara: also add dropout/temperature fixed to 0.0/0.0 for deterministic comparsion.
ryan: good call — done.
bench-bot: Re-run complete (id=jb-8593). Summary: int4 w/ shim - semantic-fail +0.6% (better), BLEU -0.6%. Artifacts: /ci/artifacts/1857234567/int4-shim.json
maria: OK that's useful. Int4 looks borderline for legal summarization. For PLG product defaults we probably keep int8 for now and enable int4 as an experimental profile with warnings.
kevin: agree. Action items: (1) publish int4 as 'experimental-legal' profile with prompt-sensitivity note, (2) add tokenizer shim by default for int4 until we root cause, (3) schedule a deeper numeric stability pass on the quant kernels next sprint.
zara: I'll add eval checks to the rollout gating: require semantic-fail delta <=0.5% and automated sample diff review if >0.3%.
maria: thanks team. Ryan — can you open a PR with bench results + sample diffs and tag me? :thumbsup:
ryan: will do, PR up in ~30m (link to follow).
kevin: noted, will reserve a slot for kernel triage next Wednesday.
maria: closing loop — nice quick sync. If anyone sees anything else odd ping here. :white_check_mark:
